gate: Remediation exit gate (plan node fixgate), and Phase 7's exit gate (plan node p7)

scope: Structural criteria that hold whatever the model's quality. No model ran in Phase 7: the owner deferred every GPU run to after Phase 9 (2026-10-04), so every test here drives the controller with a scripted model, an in-process forge and local git repositories. Nothing was pushed, opened or merged anywhere.

evidence.note: no test this file cites, and no test in internal/remediation, contains a Skip, Skipf or SkipNow call; the scan's own negative control finds a planted one. Two stale conditional skips in internal/handoff (a schema gap closed on 2026-08-07) were turned into failures on 2026-10-04
re-anchoring uses the one fingerprint: the diff-aware rescan is Lane B itself (LaneBRescan), and a finding whose rule stopped matching while its code did not change stays in the queue
a refused three-way apply leaves the tree exactly as it was

rows.criterion: No path reaches a merge API

evidence.note: the client's six-route allowlist (five, and since the review a read-only list of open pull requests from one head) holds no merge route; eight merge and write routes are refused before a socket opens; seen failing on 2026-10-04 with a merge route added
no string literal in any non-test Go file of the module has a merge call's shape; the pattern's own negative control matches four

rows.criterion: Generation has no credentials or stray sockets

evidence.note: a real child process: the parent holds GITHUB_TOKEN, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, ANVIL_PUSH_TOKEN and HTTPS_PROXY and the child sees only its marker; the endpoint's key arrives in the Authorization header without passing through any environment; seen failing on 2026-10-04 with the parent's environment passed through

rows.limit: The socket check is what the child holds when it answers, read from /proc: a socket opened and closed during the call would not show. The child is Anvil's own code and executes nothing the model writes, so a stray socket would be a defect in it, not an injection; no network namespace confines it.

rows.criterion: The push token's scope excludes merge

evidence.note: a token with push, maintain or admin on the upstream is refused before anything is pushed (Anvil pushes to a fork), and so is one whose permissions the forge does not report; seen failing on 2026-10-04 under both mutations
the push process's credential helper gives the token to the fork's host and to no other

rows.limit: The check reads GitHub's permissions object, the token holder's role on the upstream, which decides whether it could merge there; token scopes are not read. Against a test server: no live GitHub call was made (the owner chose the fake forge only for Phase 7).

a lease lost during generation or during the last rung before the commit writes no commit and no attempt; seen failing on 2026-10-04 with the renew before the commit removed

evidence.note: bubblewrap with an allowlisted file system: from inside, this test binary cannot reach a listener on the host, read a secret kept beside the test (outside /tmp), or write there; outside, the same binary can. rows.limit: Bubblewrap needs unprivileged user namespaces. A host without them, or without bubblewrap (GitHub's hosted runners may be either), refuses the build, and there the test proves the refusal, not the confinement (docs/controls.md, U12).
